summary: This note describes Al-Farabi Kazakh National University (KazNU), presented as the oldest classical university in Kazakhstan. It covers its founding by a 1933 decree of the Kazakh Regional Committee office, a name change roughly a year after Kazakhstan's 1990 independence declaration, and its position in the QS World University Rankings.
one_line: Al-Farabi Kazakh National University (KazNU), Kazakhstan's oldest classical university, founded in 1933 and ranked 207th by QS.
key_facts: KazNU is described as the oldest classical university of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
KazNU was established by a Decree of the Kazakh Regional Committee (KRC) office dated November 13, 1933.
One year after Kazakhstan's 1990 declaration of independence, the university's name was changed to Al-Farabi Kazakh State University.
According to the QS World University Rankings, KazNU takes 207th place in the rating of the best universities of the world.
